question: Estimate the size of the Indian space-tech opportunity by 2030.
idealClarificationQuestions: Total space industry revenue (govt + private)? Yes.
Launch services + satellites + downstream (geo-imagery, IoT)? All.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: ISRO budget + revenue (commercial via NSIL): ~₹25,000 Cr by 2030.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Satellite manufacturing (Indian-built for global + Indian buyers): ~₹15,000 Cr.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Private space launch (Skyroot, Agnikul, Pixxel, Bellatrix)
Satellite manufacturing (Indian-built for global + Indian buyers)

calculationFlow: ISRO budget + revenue (commercial via NSIL): ~₹25,000 Cr by 2030.
Private space launch (Skyroot, Agnikul, Pixxel, Bellatrix): ~₹8,000 Cr.
Satellite manufacturing (Indian-built for global + Indian buyers): ~₹15,000 Cr.
Downstream services (Earth observation imagery, IoT comms, agri-intelligence): ~₹20,000 Cr.
Total: ~₹74,000 Cr (~$9B) Indian space industry by 2030.
